# Date picker

Date picker. A button that opens a calendar, for one date or a range. Built from the system's own button, popover and calendar, after shadcn/ui's Date Picker (MIT). Reads the shadcn variables, which theme.css maps onto the scheme's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale that shadcn.css maps onto the scheme's tokens. The placeholder is a prop, so the words come from the scheme.

See it in [Storybook](http://localhost:6006) under Components / Date picker, in every theme.

## Tokens it reads

From shadcn/ui. It reads shadcn's variables, which theme.css maps onto this system's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale in shadcn.css.
